Message:
“Wake up...please...
Open your eyes...!”

I repeated those words
over and over,
but the Hero’s eyes
stayed shut.

Even though I kept
telling myself,
“This can’t be, this can’t be,”

the doubts in my heart
grew with each passing day.

—Could it be that,
all that talk about
the dead being able to
come back to life,
was a lie?

—Could it be that...
Solomon deceived me...?

If so...then everything
I’ve done...was wrong...

And all I’ve done...
was kill him...!
...Aah... AAAAAAAAH...!

...Someone has begun
dispelling my
Curse of spirits...

Ah, I see...
They’ve come to kill
the witch at the center
of the Curse... Me...

...Why?
All I wanted was to
save the one I love...
Why did nothing go right?!

Ah, the last part of
my Curse has been dispelled...
Now they appear before me,
weapons ready to kill a witch.

Wait, that’s the
Successor of the Staff.
The one who...possesses
the same spirit as him.
...Ah. Aaaah...!

A heart so noble,
it was chosen by the Staff.
A spirit with
the same shape as his!

I’ve finally found it.
With this, the Hero is
sure to awaken!

“Ah, I’m so glad
you’ve come for me.
I’ve been waiting
so long for this day.

The day I could meet
my beloved...my destiny...
You.”
